results.title: Sophon denies blocking charter bid
results.description: House Speaker Sophon Zarum denies rejecting an opposition bid to amend the constitution, saying the parliamentary secretariat found it failed to meet procedural requirements.

results.title: Second Amendment Lesson: Britain Disarmed Its Citizens, Now Requires a Police License to Sell Kitchen Knives
results.description: Americans can still buy a kitchen knife without asking the police, but Britain's Home Office announced on Wednesday that every business and private individual who sells a knife of any kind, butter knives and steak knives included, will need a government license to do it. results.title: MP Sabina Chege Calls on Speaker Wetang’ula to Identify Lawmaker Who Took Her iPhone in 2023
results.description: Sabina Chege, a Jubilee‑nominated MP, urged Speaker Moses Wetang’ula to name the parliamentarian who allegedly stole her week‑old iPhone during a June 2023 clash in the National Assembly.
